_doc: Organ description profiles (Docs/Body/Plan_CharacterDescription.md). Organs reference one by BodyInternal_Base.descriptionProfile. Base text = dictionary key <current trait of baseTraitGroup>_bodydesc if it exists, else the first matching base row. Each $group$ in the base text is filled by the first matching row of that group (own groups replace same-named ruleset groups; later rulesets win over earlier ones). Row conditions: requireTraits/excludeTraits, sensitivity/expansion {min,max} (skill level of this organ), contentState [empty|some|visible|extreme], requireContentTags/excludeContentTags, requireEquip, requireEquipTags/excludeEquipTags, cycleStages [Menstrual|PreOvulation|Ovulation|Rest|Pregnant|PostPregnancy|Proestrus|Estrus|Interestrus], arousal {min,max} (sex stimulation ~0-100), lubrication {min,max} (EffectiveLubrication, organs needing lubrication only), virgin. Fragment placeholders: $item$ $content$ $name$. A personality rewords any key with the dictionary key <key>@<personalityID>. Preview: Tools/Text Authoring/Body Description Preview (play mode).
